inputs.text: Bill C-12, the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, received royal assent on March 26, 2026, and stands as yet another calculated crackdown on immigration and asylum rules that specifically targets Nigerians and other migrants from the Global South. What gets dressed up as defending sovereignty is really just a move to deepen systemic inequality and shield the power and privileges of those already on top at the expense of the most vulnerable. These policies keep scapegoating newcomers instead of confronting the structural drivers like poverty, exploitation, and historical injustices that force people to seek safety and opportunity abroad. This is a clear step backward that discriminates against marginalized communities and chooses exclusion over advancing basic human rights and labor protections for everyone.
